Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp varchar2(10) := null;
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then
 begin
 select 'TEMP' 
 into temp 
 from valid_system_parameters 
 where parameter_code = :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code 
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 temp := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if temp is not null then
 show_error('9200'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 check_dup number;
 temp number;
begin
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into temp 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type = 'PRMTY' 
 and code = :valid_system_parameters.parameter_type; 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if temp <= 0 then
 show_error('9304'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;

 if :control_block.code != :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code and 
 :control_block.type != :valid_system_parameters.parameter_type then
 check_insert_rg('valid_param', 'C10C05', 
 :control_block.code || ',' || :control_block.type || ',', 
 'D', check_dup);
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('valid_param', 'C10C05', 
 :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code || ',' || :valid_system_parameters.parameter_type || ',',
 'C', check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('9200'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 else
 check_insert_rg('valid_param', 'C10C05',
 :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code || ',' || :valid_system_parameters.parameter_type || ',',
 'U', check_dup);
 
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the Effective Date in MM-DD-YYYY format

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_sysdate date;
 t_eff_date date;
 temp varchar2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then
 if trunc(:valid_system_parameters.eff_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select 'TEMP' 
 into temp 
 from valid_system_parameters 
 where parameter_code = :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code 
 and term_date is not null 
 and :valid_system_parameters.eff_date between eff_date and term_date;
 
 message('Code exist for this effective date!!!'); pause;
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('CHANGED') then
 t_eff_date := get_item_property('valid_system_parameters.eff_date', database_value);
 if t_eff_date != :valid_system_parameters.eff_date then
 if trunc(:valid_system_parameters.eff_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select 'TEMP' 
 into temp 
 from valid_system_parameters 
 where parameter_code = :valid_system_parameters.parameter_code 
 and term_date is not null 
 and :valid_system_parameters.eff_date between eff_date and term_date;
 
 message('Code exist for this effective date!!!'); pause;
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if :valid_system_parameters.term_date is not null then
 if trunc(:valid_system_parameters.term_date) < trunc(:valid_system_parameters.eff_date) then
 next_item;
 show_error('8052');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('3141');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_insert_rg (v_rg_name in VARCHAR2, v_col_det in VARCHAR2,
 v_data_string in VARCHAR2, v_mode in VARCHAR2,
 i_out out INTEGER) IS
 h_rg RECORDGROUP;
 h_col GROUPCOLUMN;
 i_row INTEGER;
 v_char_col VARCHAR2(40); /* record group data */
 n_num_col NUMBER(20, 5); /* record group data */
 d_DATE_col DATE; /* record group data */
 v_char_data VARCHAR2(40); /* actual data */
 n_num_data NUMBER(20, 5); /* actual data */
 d_date_data DATE; /* actual data */
 v_col_name VARCHAR2(40);
 i_j INTEGER := 0; /* for createing coumn name */
 i_i INTEGER := 0; /* variable for positioning of col_det in string */
 v_match VARCHAR2(2) := NULL;
 i_start INTEGER := 1;
 dup_record EXCEPTION;
 next_column EXCEPTION;
 error_exit EXCEPTION;
 chk_record EXCEPTION;
 del_record EXCEPTION;
 add_record EXCEPTION;
 no_record EXCEPTION;
BEGIN
 i_out := 0;
 h_rg := FIND_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 
 IF ID_NULL(h_rg) THEN
 RAISE error_exit;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'A'
 THEN
 RAISE add_record;
 END IF;
 
 i_row := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(h_rg);
 i_i := 1;
 
 FOR i_x IN 1..i_row LOOP
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det, i_i, 1)) = 'C' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 v_char_col := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 v_char_data := SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start));
 IF v_char_col = v_char_data THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det, i_i, 1)) = 'N' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 n_num_col := GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 n_num_data := TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start)));
 
 IF n_num_col = n_num_data THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'D' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 d_date_col := GET_GROUP_DATE_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 d_date_data := TO_DATE(SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start)),'MM/DD/YYYY');
 
 IF d_date_col = d_date_data THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF v_match = 'OK' THEN
 i_i := i_i + 3;
 IF i_i > NVL(length(v_col_det), 0) THEN
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'D' THEN
 i_i := i_x;
 RAISE del_record;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'U' THEN
 RAISE dup_record;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'C' THEN
 RAISE chk_record;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 RAISE next_column;
 ELSE
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN next_column THEN
 i_start := INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) + 1;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 
 i_j := 0;
 i_i := 1;
 i_start := 1;
 END LOOP;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'U' THEN
 RAISE add_record;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'D' THEN
 RAISE no_record;
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'C' THEN
 i_out := 0;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN add_record THEN
 i_row := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(h_rg);
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(h_rg,END_OF_GROUP);
 i_row := i_row + 1;
 i_j := 0;
 i_i := 1;
 i_start := 1;
 
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'C' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 v_char_data := SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start));
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(h_col, i_row, v_char_data);
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det, i_i, 1)) = 'N' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 n_num_data := TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start)));
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(h_col, i_row, n_num_data);
 END IF;
 
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det, i_i, 1)) = 'D' THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 d_date_data := TO_DATE(SUBSTR(v_data_string, i_start, (INSTR(v_data_string, ',', i_start) - i_start)),'MM/DD/YYYY');
 SET_GROUP_DATE_CELL(h_col, i_row, d_date_data);
 END IF;
 
 i_i := i_i + 3;
 
 IF i_i > NVL(LENGTH(v_col_det), 0) THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 
 i_start := INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) + 1;
 END;
 END LOOP;

 WHEN dup_record THEN
 i_out := i_row;
 WHEN del_record THEN
 DELETE_GROUP_ROW(h_rg, i_i);
 WHEN chk_record THEN
 i_out := 1;
 WHEN no_record THEN
 i_out := 1;
 WHEN error_exit THEN
 i_out := 99999;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE create_rg (v_rg_nme VARCHAR2, v_rmk VARCHAR2) IS
 h_rg RECORDGROUP;
 v_rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := v_rg_nme;
 h_gc GROUPCOLUMN;
 n_errcode NUMBER;
 n_i NUMBER;
 v_col_name VARCHAR2(6);
 i_j INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
 h_rg := FIND_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 
 IF ID_NULL(h_rg) THEN
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 ELSE
 DELETE_GROUP(h_rg);
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 END IF;
 
 n_i := 1;
 
 loop
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i, 1) = 'C' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg,v_col_name, CHAR_COLUMN,
 to_NUMBER(substr(v_rmk, n_i + 1, 2)));
 END IF;
 
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i, 1) = 'N' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg, v_col_name, NUMBER_COLUMN);
 END IF;
 
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i,1) = 'D' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg, v_col_name, DATE_COLUMN);
 END IF;
 
 n_i := n_i + 3;
 
 IF n_i > NVL(LENGTH(v_rmk), 0) THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;
